topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: I can't quite shake the image of the old, rusted box I unearthed today from the garden. It wasn't there when I planted those roses last spring, or so I thought. The leather has worn thin, and the metal clasp is nearly corroded through. I opened it, hands trembling, to find a stack of yellowed letters and a small, intricately carved wooden toy. The letters are sealed, addressed to someone named 'Felicity.' I’ve never known a Felicity, but the handwriting... it looks so familiar. Maybe it’s from a long-lost family member? I’m not sure what to do next. Should I try to find out more, or just leave it alone, respecting whatever privacy it holds?
